name: a fanned stack of pages builds into one issue
looks: On a light field beside a headline about distilling everything into one issue, a cover page sits in front of a fanned stack of numbered pages behind it, the stack thickening slightly as a short table of contents list fills in on the cover.
build: variant-stack-reveal: the fanned pages behind the cover are near-identical DOM sheets offset in a tight rotation gradient; the table-of-contents rows on the cover fade/slide in top to bottom, staggered.
sound: A soft paper-shuffle texture as the stack settles, a tick per list row.
prompt: Beside a headline about combining many pieces into one issue, show a cover page in front of a tightly fanned stack of numbered pages, with a short table of contents filling in row by row on the cover. Use it to make "everything in one place" physically visible as a stack rather than just stated.
